name: Lunary
tagline: Open-source observability and prompt management for LLM apps.
description: An open-source platform for monitoring, debugging, and improving LLM applications and chatbots. Lunary combines request tracing, cost and user analytics, versioned prompt management with A/B testing, plus human-in-the-loop review and automated scoring. Self-host the Apache-2.0 community edition or use the managed cloud, which starts free with a 10k-events monthly tier.

modelSupport.notes: Integrates across providers — OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Vertex, Hugging Face, and more.

edge: Bundles prompt versioning, A/B tests, and human review with tracing — fast zero-to-observability for RAG/chatbots.
pros: Cost and user analytics built in
